svg.title: Jing-Zhang City Completeness v0.6 Three Flagship Pilot Protocols
svg.desc: Concept test protocols for a controlled low-speed robot trial in Zhongzhiyuan, accessibility and care navigation in the AI Origin Community, and interchange/multilingual wayfinding in Dazhongsi.
svg.text: v0.6 | Three flagship pilots: validate before scaling
All quantities and durations are conceptual test configurations, not approved budgets, contracts, permits, sites, or partnership commitments.

g.text: Question: how can R&D testing avoid turning public routes into default test space?
Ordinary walking + human delivery + staffed on-site guidance
at least 2 human marshal roles per active test window
Site permission, fire/egress, device safety, insurance/liability,
physical separation and human takeover confirmed before start
No spill into unauthorized routes; takeover reachable;
ordinary movement not degraded; incidents reviewable
Boundary breach, loss of link, blocked accessible path, takeover failure
Device removal + temporary-space reset + incident/data cleanup record
A: real operating authority (to be confirmed)
Question: can digital assistance enhance, rather than replace, physical access?
Continuous physical accessibility + fixed signs + staffed help desk
10–20 voluntary, withdrawable use sessions as a concept cap
Accessibility review, service hours, human help, data minimization,
consent/exit and equal service without registration confirmed
2–4 week small-scale co-test → GO / REVISE / STOP
Route completion not below baseline; human help reachable;
refusing tracking never removes basic service; errors appealable
Misdirection to inaccessible path, sensitive-data breach, no human review
Personalization off + deletion/migration record + baseline continues
A: real public-service authority (to be confirmed)
R: staffed service lead; C: accessibility/privacy/community;
Question: can AI improve legibility without creating a dependency?
Static signs + staffed advice + routes understandable without a phone
Chinese / English and no-phone modes all remain available
Real entrances, opening hours, property/operations interface,
accessibility and emergency wayfinding verified before testing
Wayfinding time/help requests improve against baseline;
static signs stand alone; bad advice is human-correctable
Unsafe routing, conflict with live site state, failed human update
AI layer off + physical signs retained + correction/closure notice
A: real station-city/public-interface authority (to be confirmed)
R: on-site information lead; C: transport/accessibility/operations;
I: commuters, visitors and nearby residents

svg.text: v0.6 states quantity bases, staff roles and test durations only. Currency budget, total FTE, procurement, insurance, contracts and permits stay UNKNOWN until site and accountable parties are confirmed.
Concept proposal only. Provisional geometry remains non-official; no pilot above is represented as executed, funded, approved or contracted.
